cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是英国广播公司国际台的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Pete Ross, and this edition is published in the later hours of Friday, the 14th of August.
cues.zh: 我是皮特·罗斯，本期节目于8月14日星期五晚间发布。

cues.en: Raised eyebrows in Britain as Benjamin Netanyahu calls the UK an Islamic Republic.
cues.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡称英国为“伊斯兰共和国”，在英国引发质疑。

cues.en: In Japan, several people have died after unprecedented rainfall has caused flooding and landslides.
cues.zh: 在日本，史无前例的降雨引发洪水和山体滑坡，已造成数人死亡。

cues.en: The UN raises fears for food security if the extreme weather continues.
cues.zh: 联合国警告，如果极端天气持续，粮食安全将面临威胁。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, the leader of Britain's right-wing Reform Party, Nigel Farage, is re-elected as an MP.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将报道，英国右翼政党英国改革党党首奈杰尔·法拉奇再次当选议员。

cues.en: In the middle of August, in holiday season, we have secured far more votes than we got in the general election of 2024!
cues.zh: 在八月中旬、正值度假季的时候，我们获得的选票远超2024年大选！

cues.en: But investigations into his finances go on.
cues.zh: 但针对其财务状况的调查仍在继续。

cues.en: Relations between Israel and the UK have been strained for a while.
cues.zh: 以色列与英国的关系紧张已有一段时间。

cues.en: But the Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, appears to have risked making them worse still by suggesting Britain is now an Islamic Republic.
cues.zh: 但以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡称英国如今是一个“伊斯兰共和国”，似乎可能令两国关系进一步恶化。

cues.en: In a podcast with Israeli Army Radio, Mr Netanyahu recalled meeting the grandson of Winston Churchill, describing him as a “lover of Israel”.
cues.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在以色列陆军电台的一档播客中回忆，自己曾见过温斯顿·丘吉尔的孙子，并称其为“热爱以色列的人”。

cues.en: He then remarked that you won't find that kind of attitude in the UK now, which he said was known as the Islamic Republic of Britain.
cues.zh: 他随后说，如今在英国已找不到这种态度，并称英国被叫作“大不列颠伊斯兰共和国”。

cues.en: He'd been talking about how the Six-Day War in 1967 was reported on by Winston Churchill's son and grandson, both journalists at the time.
cues.zh: 他此前谈到，温斯顿·丘吉尔的儿子和孙子当时都是记者，曾报道1967年的六日战争。

cues.en: By the way, he and his father, Randolph, Churchill's son, came here and covered the Six-Day War here in a very positive way for us.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，他和他的父亲兰道夫，也就是丘吉尔的儿子，曾来到这里，以对我们非常正面的方式报道六日战争。

cues.en: Try finding that in Britain now, in what is called the Islamic Republic of Britain.
cues.zh: 如今你试着在英国找找看吧——那里被称作“大不列颠伊斯兰共和国”。

cues.en: A spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister's Office, David Mencer, said Mr Netanyahu was merely quoting the American Vice President, JD Vance.
cues.zh: 以色列总理办公室发言人大卫·门瑟表示，内塔尼亚胡只是在引用美国副总统J.D.万斯的话。

cues.en: Uh, he was quoting something that someone else had said.
cues.zh: 呃，他是在引用别人说过的话。

cues.en: His, his exact words were, “Someone had called it that.”
cues.zh: 他、他的原话是：“有人曾这样称呼它。”

cues.en: Uh, and when you look into it, it was actually Vice President Vance, JD Vance, who made those comments at the Munich Security Summit.
cues.zh: 呃，查证后会发现，实际上是在慕尼黑安全会议上发表那些言论的万斯副总统，也就是J.D.万斯。

cues.en: But also at a, uh, convention in 2024.
cues.zh: 此外，他还在2024年的一次大会上说过。

cues.en: So those are the words of the Vice President.
cues.zh: 所以，那些话出自美国副总统。

cues.en: I asked our correspondent in Jerusalem, Yolande Knell, what we should make of the comments.
cues.zh: 我请驻耶路撒冷记者约兰德·内尔分析该如何看待这些言论。

cues.en: Well, he's speaking in a long podcast with a host on Israeli Army Radio, a man who lost his son in Gaza.
cues.zh: 嗯，他是在以色列陆军电台的一档长篇播客中讲话，主持人的儿子在加沙丧生。

cues.en: And you have to remember that the Israeli Prime Minister is currently in campaign mode, with these elections due at the end of October.
cues.zh: 还要记住，以色列总理目前正处于竞选状态，选举定于十月底举行。

cues.en: And he's currently trailing in the polls.
cues.zh: 而且他目前在民调中落后。

cues.en: Now, he recalled meeting the writer and grandson of Winston Churchill, also called Winston,
cues.zh: 他回忆起见到作家、温斯顿·丘吉尔的孙子——同样名叫温斯顿——

cues.en: who he said had represented Israel in a very positive way, along with his father Randolph.
cues.zh: 并称此人与父亲兰道夫都曾非常正面地报道以色列。

cues.en: He then went on to contrast that relationship with the UK today. He said, “Try to find that now in Britain. You could, of course, call it the Islamic Republic of Britain.”
cues.zh: 随后，内塔尼亚胡把那种关系与当今英国作了对比。他说：“如今你试着在英国找找看吧。当然，你可以把它称作‘大不列颠伊斯兰共和国’。”

cues.en: And he added that, you know, it could potentially be the first Islamic republic with nuclear weapons, seemingly forgetting about the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
cues.zh: 他还说，你知道，这可能会成为第一个拥有核武器的伊斯兰共和国，似乎忘记了巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国。

cues.en: And it's really being read as, you know, underlining the deterioration, I guess, in relations between Israel and the UK.
cues.zh: 而这番话被解读为，你知道，凸显了以色列与英国关系的恶化。

cues.en: These are two countries that have historically been close allies.
cues.zh: 两国在历史上一直是亲密盟友。

cues.en: They cooperate diplomatically and on security matters.
cues.zh: 两国在外交和安全事务上开展合作。

cues.en: And a lot of that has been to do with Britain taking a more critical stance over Israel's conduct of the war in Gaza.
cues.zh: 关系恶化很大程度上与英国对以色列在加沙战争中的行为采取了更严厉的立场有关。

cues.en: And the Israeli government has repeatedly criticized the UK's Labour government since it moved to recognize a Palestinian state.
cues.zh: 自英国工党政府着手承认巴勒斯坦国以来，以色列政府已多次提出批评。

cues.en: Mr Netanyahu argues that such measures risk rewarding Hamas. But it's not just the UK.
cues.zh: 内塔尼亚胡认为，这类举措可能是在奖赏哈马斯。但他针对的不只是英国。

cues.en: He's also saying that demographic changes across all of Europe—Muslims immigrating to Europe—have led to kind of increased criticism of Israel's policies.
cues.zh: 他还称，整个欧洲的人口结构变化——穆斯林移民欧洲——导致了对以色列政策某种程度上日益增多的批评。

cues.en: He made these comments in Hebrew when asked about Israel's increased isolation on the international stage.
cues.zh: 他是在被问及以色列在国际舞台上日益孤立时，用希伯来语发表这些言论的。

cues.en: On an army podcast, it's clearly for an Israeli audience.
cues.zh: 这些话出现在一档军方播客中，显然面向以色列受众。

cues.en: Do you think he expected them to go more widespread than that? And if so, what should we make of it?
cues.zh: 你认为他预料到这些话会传播得更广吗？如果是这样，我们该如何理解？

cues.en: Yeah, certainly it was primarily for a domestic audience, and as I say, he's in campaign mode.
cues.zh: 是的，这主要是说给国内受众听的；正如我所说，他正处于竞选状态。

cues.en: But also, this is an important moment, isn't it?
cues.zh: 但与此同时，这也是一个重要时刻，不是吗？

cues.en: We've just got a new Prime Minister in the UK, Andy Burnham.
cues.zh: 英国刚刚迎来新首相安迪·伯纳姆。

cues.en: He has been looking to recalibrate Labour's position on the Middle East.
cues.zh: 他一直在寻求重新调整工党在中东问题上的立场。

cues.en: He has apologized for the Labour Party's initial response to Israeli actions in Gaza.
cues.zh: 他已就工党最初对以色列在加沙行动的回应道歉。

cues.en: The former Prime Minister was deemed to have been slow in calling for a ceasefire.
cues.zh: 外界认为，前首相迟迟没有呼吁停火。

cues.en: He said that Labour must do better.
cues.zh: 他说，工党必须做得更好。

cues.en: And in a video message just last month, he said that the UK should be clear in its criticism of events in Gaza.
cues.zh: 就在上个月的一段视频讲话中，他说英国应当明确批评加沙发生的事件。

cues.en: And simultaneously should condemn the Hamas-led attack on 7 October 2023, and anti-Semitism—that is, the different incidents that have been happening in the UK.
cues.zh: 同时也应谴责哈马斯主导的2023年10月7日袭击，以及反犹主义，也就是英国发生的各种相关事件。

cues.en: So there's an expectation here that his government is going to take a harder line than perhaps the government that came before.
cues.zh: 因此，人们预期他的政府会采取比前一届政府更强硬的立场。

cues.en: So I think Mr Netanyahu will see this as, you know, serving a dual purpose.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，内塔尼亚胡会觉得这番话可以同时达到两个目的。

cues.en: You know, it will resonate with some of the Israeli public.
cues.zh: 你知道，这会引起一部分以色列公众的共鸣。

cues.en: But he also imagines that, you know, these remarks can of course be translated, especially nowadays in the media, and will be picked up by the UK.
cues.zh: 但他也料到，你知道，这些言论当然会被翻译，尤其在如今的媒体环境下，并会被英国方面注意到。

cues.en: Yolande Knell in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 约兰德·内尔在耶路撒冷报道。

cues.en: To Japan now, where record rainfall has caused flooding in the east of the country near Tokyo, leaving several people dead.
cues.zh: 现在转向日本。东京附近的日本东部地区遭遇创纪录降雨并引发洪水，造成数人死亡。

cues.en: Chiba Prefecture has had more than three times its average rainfall this month alone.
cues.zh: 仅本月，千叶县的降雨量就已超过月平均值的三倍。

cues.en: This comes after a series of storms swept through Japan and neighbouring countries, in what forecasters say is an unusually active typhoon season.
cues.zh: 在此之前，一连串风暴横扫了日本及其邻国；预报员称，今年的台风季异常活跃。

cues.en: Our Tokyo correspondent Kurumi Mori told me more.
cues.zh: 本台驻东京记者森久留美向我介绍了更多情况。

cues.en: We're seeing record rainfall in Chiba Prefecture. Now, that is a prefecture to the east of Tokyo.
cues.zh: 千叶县正遭遇创纪录的降雨。千叶县位于东京以东。

cues.en: The Japan Meteorological Agency has declared that this is unprecedented.
cues.zh: 日本气象厅表示，这种情况前所未有。

cues.en: The Japan Self-Defense Forces have been deployed to the area to help people who are trapped and stuck in flooded areas, and get them to safety.
cues.zh: 日本自卫队已被部署到当地，帮助受困于洪水地区的民众转移到安全地带。

cues.en: Authorities warn that more heavy rain is still possible, so they are cautioning people to stay alert.
cues.zh: 当局警告仍可能出现更多强降雨，因此提醒民众保持警惕。

cues.en: And Chiba Prefecture, which, as you say, is right next to the capital, Tokyo, must be a fairly heavily populated part of the country.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，千叶县紧邻首都东京，想必是日本人口相当稠密的地区。

cues.en: What has been the impact for people living there?
cues.zh: 这对当地居民造成了什么影响？

cues.en: Yeah, absolutely. I mean, there are a lot of commuters, as you can imagine.
cues.zh: 是的，确实如此。可以想见，那里有许多通勤者。

cues.en: So far, we're seeing more than 19,000 households still without power, as of the last check.
cues.zh: 截至最近一次核实，仍有超过1.9万户家庭断电。

cues.en: About 100,000 to 400,000 people were ordered to evacuate last night.
cues.zh: 昨晚约有10万至40万人接到疏散命令。

cues.en: At the peak, roads were submerged in water.
cues.zh: 灾情最严重时，道路被水淹没。

cues.en: I spoke to a Chiba resident who was telling me that they're seeing a bunch of abandoned cars left out on the roads because the roads are still flooded.
cues.zh: 我采访了一名千叶居民。他告诉我，由于道路仍然被淹，路上可以看到许多被遗弃的汽车。

cues.en: And also, at the BBC, we just got off the phone with the JMA, Japan's weather agency, and they told us that the special warning has been lifted,
cues.zh: 另外，我们BBC刚刚与日本气象厅通了电话。他们告诉我们，特别警报已经解除，

cues.en: but people are still urged to remain cautious because the atmospheric conditions remain unstable.
cues.zh: 但由于大气状况仍不稳定，民众依然被敦促保持警惕。

cues.en: And just how unusual is this amount of rainfall in Japan?
cues.zh: 那么，这样的降雨量在日本究竟有多反常？

cues.en: Heavy summer rain isn't anything particularly new.
cues.zh: 夏季强降雨并不算特别新鲜。

cues.en: It's more about how intense these downpours can become, and how quickly they can overwhelm roads, infrastructure and drainage systems.
cues.zh: 问题更多在于暴雨会变得多么猛烈，以及它能多快压垮道路、基础设施和排水系统。

cues.en: This week is a holiday in Japan. It's called Obon. That's when we traditionally travel back to our hometowns.
cues.zh: 本周是日本的假期，名为盂兰盆节。按照传统，人们会在这时返乡。

cues.en: So the storm is also having an impact there, with reports of travellers being stranded at Narita Airport—around 7,000 of them stranded.
cues.zh: 风暴也影响了假期出行。据报道，约有7000名旅客滞留在成田机场。

cues.en: This is not the first of these types of storms that Japan has experienced in the last couple of weeks.
cues.zh: 这并不是过去几周日本遭遇的第一场此类风暴。

cues.en: No, you know, we've been seeing quite an interesting variety of weather events and natural disasters.
cues.zh: 不是。我们近来见到了种类相当多样的天气事件和自然灾害。

cues.en: We had an earthquake in Kumamoto, followed by quite a severe heatwave, where we saw up to 18,000 people hospitalised for heatstroke in just one week in late July,
cues.zh: 熊本先是发生地震，随后又遭遇相当严重的热浪。仅7月下旬的一周内，就有多达1.8万人因中暑住院，

cues.en: followed by this severe rainfall in Chiba Prefecture. And a short while ago, the government reported a volcanic eruption happening in Japan.
cues.zh: 接着就是千叶县的这场强降雨。不久前，日本政府还报告发生了火山喷发。

cues.en: We're getting everything on all sides when it comes to these extreme weather events and these natural disasters.
cues.zh: 说到极端天气事件和自然灾害，我们简直是四面受袭、什么都遇上了。

cues.en: Kurumi Mori in Tokyo.
cues.zh: 森久留美在东京报道。

cues.en: From one weather event to another: the extreme heat ravaging much of Europe.
cues.zh: 从一种天气事件转向另一种：极端高温正肆虐欧洲大部分地区。

cues.en: Temperatures have reached well above 40°C in some places, and that's prompted growing alarm about the damage being done to the planet and its inhabitants.
cues.zh: 一些地方的气温远超40摄氏度，人们越来越担忧这会给地球及其居民造成损害。

cues.en: Now the United Nations has added its voice to flag concerns about the pressure extreme weather events like drought are putting on food security.
cues.zh: 如今，联合国也发出警示，担忧干旱等极端天气事件正给粮食安全带来压力。

cues.en: Kaveh Zahedi from the UN's Food and Agriculture Organization told my colleague Kasia Madera that the weather to come could make the problem even more pronounced.
cues.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织的卡韦·扎赫迪告诉我的同事卡西娅·马德拉，未来的天气可能会使问题更加突出。

cues.en: We're concerned across the board, because the combined impact of the droughts and the extreme heat that we're seeing is becoming, essentially, a serious threat to food security.
cues.zh: 我们对各方面都感到担忧，因为我们所看到的干旱与极端高温的叠加影响，实际上正成为粮食安全的严重威胁。

cues.en: Of course, with extreme heat, first and foremost we see an impact on the staple crops—the staple crops that feed the world.
cues.zh: 当然，极端高温首先会影响主粮作物，也就是养活全世界的那些基本粮食作物。

cues.en: We're talking about maize, rice, soy and wheat, some of the ones that you mentioned.
cues.zh: 这里说的是玉米、水稻、大豆和小麦，也就是你刚才提到的其中几种。

cues.en: We know that for every 1°C increase in average global temperatures, there's going to be around a 7% decrease in yields for these four major crops,
cues.zh: 我们知道，全球平均气温每升高1摄氏度，这四种主要作物的产量就会下降约7%，

cues.en: which essentially provide 60% of global calories.
cues.zh: 而这四种作物提供了全球约60%的热量。

cues.en: But these are global averages, and we know that single events can have much, much bigger impacts.
cues.zh: 不过，这些只是全球平均值；我们知道，单次事件可能造成大得多的影响。

cues.en: And we've seen that play out, including in the previous El Niño cycle.
cues.zh: 我们已经见识过这种情况，包括上一个厄尔尼诺周期。

cues.en: Well, on that, scientists are predicting a super El Niño event—that hot-air event—in the early part of next year.
cues.zh: 说到这一点，科学家预测明年年初会出现一次超级厄尔尼诺事件，也就是那种热空气事件。

cues.en: Is that going to—how is that going to exacerbate what we're already experiencing?
cues.zh: 这将会——它将如何加剧我们已经在经历的情况？

cues.en: Well, it's just going to magnify what we're already experiencing.
cues.zh: 它只会把我们已经在经历的问题进一步放大。

cues.en: We don't know exactly what El Niño holds in store for us this time around.
cues.zh: 我们并不确切知道这一次厄尔尼诺会给我们带来什么。

cues.en: Previous El Niños are not necessarily a perfect prediction of the current one,
cues.zh: 以往的厄尔尼诺不一定能完全预示这一次，

cues.en: but we've already seen, as you say, that this is going to be a strong one because of the ocean temperatures.
cues.zh: 但正如你所说，从海洋温度来看，我们已经知道这次会很强。

cues.en: What we saw last time, in the last cycle of El Niño, was extraordinary impacts.
cues.zh: 上一次，也就是上一个厄尔尼诺周期中，我们看到了非同寻常的影响。

cues.en: I mean, you take a country like Morocco.
cues.zh: 比如说摩洛哥这样的国家。

cues.en: In the last cycle, you saw extreme drought and extreme heat that led to an over 40% drop in cereal yields, and a complete failure, I guess, of olive and citrus production.
cues.zh: 在上一个周期，极端干旱和极端高温导致谷物产量下降超过40%，橄榄和柑橘生产也可以说完全失败。

cues.en: We saw cereal prices and yields drop in South Africa, potato in India, fruit and vegetables in Mexico, and rice in Indonesia.
cues.zh: 我们看到南非的谷物价格和产量下降，印度的马铃薯、墨西哥的果蔬以及印度尼西亚的水稻也受到影响。

cues.en: The list goes on and on, and I guess that's what's in store.
cues.zh: 这样的例子不胜枚举，我想这就是未来可能出现的情况。

cues.en: What's your advice, then?
cues.zh: 那么，你有什么建议？

cues.en: What's the priority here in order to build a resilient food system? Is it crop rotation?
cues.zh: 要建设有韧性的粮食体系，当前的重点是什么？是实行轮作吗？

cues.en: Is it completely revisiting the types of foodstuffs that we will be consuming going forward?
cues.zh: 还是要彻底重新审视我们今后将食用的食品种类？

cues.en: Absolutely, you've named some of the solutions.
cues.zh: 没错，你已经说出了其中一些解决办法。

cues.en: I mean, first and foremost is early warning.
cues.zh: 首先也是最重要的，是预警。

cues.en: Our farmers have to know what's around the corner to help them with their planning,
cues.zh: 农民必须知道接下来会发生什么，以便进行规划，

cues.en: so that they know what to plant, when to plant it, what to store, and how to store fodder and water,
cues.zh: 了解该种什么、何时种植、该储存什么，以及如何储存饲料和水，

cues.en: and choose the right kind of drought- and heat-tolerant seeds and breeds.
cues.zh: 并选择合适的耐旱、耐高温种子和品种。

cues.en: All of these are going to be about building resilience.
cues.zh: 所有这些措施都是为了增强韧性。

cues.en: We have to invest more in these kinds of practical solutions that save water and help to maintain moisture in our soil.
cues.zh: 我们必须加大对这类实用解决方案的投入，以节约用水并帮助土壤保持水分。

cues.en: So really, it's so much about anticipatory action, so much about early warning to prevent the worst of what El Niño could bring.
cues.zh: 所以，关键在于采取预先行动和加强预警，防止厄尔尼诺可能带来的最严重后果。

cues.en: Kaveh Zahedi.
cues.zh: 卡韦·扎赫迪。

cues.en: Back in December last year, Australia passed a law banning social media for many teenagers.
cues.zh: 去年12月，澳大利亚通过了一项法律，禁止许多青少年使用社交媒体。

cues.en: It was a first, and since then, other countries have followed suit.
cues.zh: 此举开创了先例，此后其他国家也纷纷效仿。

cues.en: Now representatives of various tech companies have been giving evidence about the ban to an Australian parliamentary inquiry.
cues.zh: 目前，多家科技公司的代表正就这项禁令向澳大利亚议会调查委员会作证。

cues.en: So what's come out of that?
cues.zh: 那么，调查目前得出了什么结果？

cues.en: I asked our correspondent in Sydney, Katy Watson.
cues.zh: 我向本台驻悉尼记者凯蒂·沃森了解了情况。

cues.en: There have been a mixture of families whose children have died or faced bullying from social media, as well as representatives of the platforms, regulators and government.
cues.zh: 参与者既有孩子已经去世或曾在社交媒体上遭受欺凌的家庭，也有平台、监管机构和政府的代表。

cues.en: They've been talking to a parliamentary inquiry about the social media ban and the changes that are going on here in Australia.
cues.zh: 他们一直在议会调查中讨论社交媒体禁令，以及澳大利亚正在发生的相关变化。

cues.en: And what has come out so far?
cues.zh: 那么，目前有什么结果？

cues.en: What has been the impact of the ban?
cues.zh: 这项禁令产生了什么影响？

cues.en: Well, I mean, if you were to ask the average teenager, as I've done in the last few months, they would say nothing's happened.
cues.zh: 嗯，我是说，如果你去问普通青少年——过去几个月我也确实问过——他们会说什么都没发生。

cues.en: I mean, it's been going for eight months,
cues.zh: 我是说，禁令已经实施八个月了；

cues.en: and certainly in March, the regulator, the eSafety Commissioner, said that it was concerned platforms weren't doing enough to uphold the ban.
cues.zh: 今年3月，监管机构——电子安全专员办公室——表示担忧，认为各平台在落实禁令方面做得不够。

cues.en: There are definitely statistics.
cues.zh: 确实有一些统计数据。

cues.en: I mean, government figures and other independent studies have shown that about eight in ten under-16s are still on social media.
cues.zh: 我是说，政府数据和其他独立研究显示，未满16岁的青少年中约有八成仍在使用社交媒体。

cues.en: That was in the first, you know, three months.
cues.zh: 你知道，这是禁令实施前三个月的数据。

cues.en: So, clearly, if you're looking at the numbers who've been pushed off platforms, not much.
cues.zh: 所以很明显，如果看实际被迫退出平台的人数，成效并不大。

cues.en: However, the government kind of talks about this as much more of a long-term issue, trying to kind of change the way people think about online safety.
cues.zh: 不过，政府认为这更像是一项长期议题，目的是逐步改变人们对网络安全的看法。

cues.en: But because of this discussion about whether it's working or not, the government has doubled the maximum fines for not complying.
cues.zh: 但由于外界一直争论禁令是否奏效，政府已将违规行为的最高罚款提高一倍。

cues.en: So, initially, they'd face fines—and it's not the children, it's not the parents, it's very much the platforms.
cues.zh: 也就是说，面临罚款的不是孩子，也不是家长，而主要是平台。

cues.en: Now they can face up to about 70 million US dollars if they're found not to be taking steps to kick under-16s off.
cues.zh: 如果被认定没有采取措施让未满16岁的用户退出，平台如今最高可能面临约7,000万美元罚款。

cues.en: So this hearing was kind of going through, talking to all of the players in this ban.
cues.zh: 因此，这场听证会正在听取这项禁令所有相关方的意见。

cues.en: And what are the tech companies saying about all this?
cues.zh: 那么，科技公司对此怎么说？

cues.en: Because from what I've read, they have closed down a number of accounts.
cues.zh: 据我所知，它们已经关闭了一批账户。

cues.en: Do they say they're on top of this?
cues.zh: 它们是否认为局面已在掌控之中？

cues.en: Yeah, so Meta kind of pre-empted this hearing, and earlier this week they put out some numbers.
cues.zh: 是的，Meta在听证会前抢先作出回应，并于本周早些时候公布了一些数据。

cues.en: They said there's a total of 750,000 accounts that have been closed since the ban.
cues.zh: Meta表示，自禁令实施以来，共有75万个账户被关闭。

cues.en: They already announced around 500,000 had been closed between Instagram and Facebook, like in the run-up to the ban.
cues.zh: 此前它们已经宣布，在禁令生效前夕，Instagram和Facebook约有50万个账户被关闭。

cues.en: So it's an extra 250,000 accounts that have been closed up until now.
cues.zh: 因此，截至目前又有25万个账户被关闭。

cues.en: Now, they say they're still monitoring it.
cues.zh: Meta表示，目前仍在持续监测。

cues.en: Every time somebody's flagged as being under 16, then they kick those people off.
cues.zh: 每当有人被标记为未满16岁，平台就会将其移除。

cues.en: But they have also made clear that they don't agree with this ban and the way it works.
cues.zh: 但Meta也明确表示，不认同这项禁令及其运作方式。

cues.en: Clearly, there's a lot of court cases that they're facing.
cues.zh: 显然，它们还面临许多法庭诉讼。

cues.en: I spoke to the Commissioner herself, who said that she's dealing with about 10 different investigations across the different platforms.
cues.zh: 我采访了电子安全专员本人。她说，自己正在围绕不同平台处理约10项调查。

cues.en: She's looking at the numbers, looking at what they're doing.
cues.zh: 她正在审查相关数据，以及各平台采取的措施。

cues.en: But fining a company will take probably a court battle, and then, you know, some.
cues.zh: 但要对公司处以罚款，很可能需要经历一场法庭争夺，甚至还不止于此。

cues.en: So it's taking a long time to actually kind of see whether this ban and these fines will actually work.
cues.zh: 因此，要真正看清这项禁令和这些罚款是否奏效，还需要很长时间。

cues.en: Katy Watson in Sydney.
cues.zh: 凯蒂·沃森在悉尼报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast:
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有：

cues.en: Now we can start to discover who has put it over there.
cues.zh: 现在我们可以开始查明，究竟是谁把它放在了那里。

cues.en: Is there a criminal side to that gold?
cues.zh: 这批黄金是否涉及犯罪？

cues.en: The mystery of the multi-million-dollar gold stash discovered in a house renovation.
cues.zh: 房屋翻修期间发现的数百万美元黄金宝藏之谜。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: The civil war in Sudan has been described as one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world.
cues.zh: 苏丹内战被形容为全球最严重的人道主义危机之一。

cues.en: The city of El Obeid has become the focal point in the conflict.
cues.zh: 欧拜伊德市已成为这场冲突的焦点。

cues.en: The rebel Rapid Support Forces are pounding the city with drones as they try to take control from government forces.
cues.zh: 反叛武装快速支援部队正用无人机猛烈攻击该市，试图从政府军手中夺取控制权。

cues.en: The two groups have been fighting since April 2023.
cues.zh: 双方自2023年4月以来一直交战。

cues.en: Thousands of children are among those fleeing to El Obeid to escape violence in other parts of the country, but conditions in the city are desperate.
cues.zh: 数千名儿童逃往欧拜伊德，以躲避苏丹其他地区的暴力，但城内的处境十分严峻。

cues.en: Francesco Lanino is the Deputy Country Director for Save the Children in Sudan.
cues.zh: 弗朗切斯科·拉尼诺是救助儿童会驻苏丹副国别主任。

cues.en: In the last few months, around 40,000 displaced children have arrived in El Obeid.
cues.zh: 过去几个月里，约有4万名流离失所儿童抵达欧拜伊德。

cues.en: And many of them arrive with their families and with almost nothing.
cues.zh: 其中许多儿童与家人一同抵达，几乎一无所有。

cues.en: And the first thing they are looking for is food, because they left with nothing.
cues.zh: 他们首先寻找的是食物，因为离开家园时什么都没带。

cues.en: So, you know, children and their families leave their homes and walk for days, looking for a safe place to go and escaping from the violence.
cues.zh: 所以，你知道，儿童和家人离开家园，徒步数日寻找安全去处，逃离暴力。

cues.en: But the city itself is now also hard to reach.
cues.zh: 但欧拜伊德本身如今也很难抵达。

cues.en: And supplies cannot really reach El Obeid in a timely way, while food prices have increased dramatically in the last few months.
cues.zh: 物资无法及时运抵欧拜伊德，而食品价格在过去几个月里大幅上涨。

cues.en: So we have a situation in which children already arrive with severe malnutrition.
cues.zh: 因此，儿童抵达时往往已经严重营养不良。

cues.en: And now, even worse, there is also a cholera outbreak.
cues.zh: 现在更糟的是，当地还暴发了霍乱。

cues.en: There is water scarcity and very bad water quality.
cues.zh: 当地缺水，水质也非常糟糕。

cues.en: All these drone attacks are also affecting, you know, all the water stations and wells.
cues.zh: 因为这些无人机袭击也正在影响，你知道，所有供水站和水井。

cues.en: At Save the Children, we now have an office in El Obeid, and we have managed to bring supplies into the city, but there are only a few routes available.
cues.zh: 救助儿童会如今在欧拜伊德设有办事处，也设法将物资运进城内，但可用路线只有寥寥几条。

cues.en: What we're finding challenging now, with all these global crises, is that the price of fuel has increased dramatically.
cues.zh: 如今，在全球多重危机之下，我们面临的一项难题是燃料价格大幅上涨。

cues.en: And then, according to several sets of data, you know, half of Sudanese children have witnessed the loss of one of their family members.
cues.zh: 而且，你知道，据多项数据，半数苏丹儿童曾目睹一名家人离世。

cues.en: They have been out of school for years and have also been displaced so many times all around the country.
cues.zh: 他们已失学多年，还在全国各地一次又一次流离失所。

cues.en: When I was in Darfur just a few weeks ago, one of the things I witnessed was the difficulty children had playing, because it was something they were not used to.
cues.zh: 就在几周前，我在达尔富尔看到的一件事，是孩子们连玩耍都很困难，因为那已经成了他们不习惯做的事情。

cues.en: So, in that context, you spend the majority of the day moving from one place to another, just fetching water or looking for food.
cues.zh: 所以，在这样的环境中，人们一天大部分时间都在四处奔波，只为取水或寻找食物。

cues.en: there is no time for being a child.
cues.zh: 根本没有时间做一个孩子。

cues.en: Francesco Lanino, speaking to us from Port Sudan.
cues.zh: 弗朗切斯科·拉尼诺在苏丹港接受了我们的采访。

cues.en: Now, listeners are unlikely ever to have heard an odder snapshot of the shape of British politics
cues.zh: 现在来看英国政治，听众恐怕再也找不到比这更奇特的缩影：

cues.en: than a parliamentary by-election held in the east of England, in the seaside town of Clacton.
cues.zh: 英格兰东部海滨小镇克拉克顿举行的一场议会补选。

cues.en: With a list of candidates literally as long as your arm—there were 34 of them—
cues.zh: 候选人名单确实长得惊人，共有34人——

cues.en: it's been won by the right-wing Reform UK leader Nigel Farage, who triggered the poll in the first place.
cues.zh: 最终胜出的是右翼政党英国改革党的领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇；正是他最初触发了这场补选。

cues.en: He'd resigned as MP for Clacton in response to an investigation into his finances.
cues.zh: 他此前因一项针对其财务状况的调查，辞去了克拉克顿议员职务。

cues.en: He received over 22,000 votes, even more than when he first won the seat two years ago.
cues.zh: 他获得了超过2.2万票，甚至多于两年前首次赢得该席位时的票数。

cues.en: On the hottest day of the year, in the middle of August, in holiday season, we have secured far more votes than we got in the general election of 2024!
cues.zh: 在一年中最炎热的一天，在8月中旬、度假旺季，我们获得的选票远远超过2024年大选！

cues.en: But all of Reform's main political rivals boycotted the election.
cues.zh: 但英国改革党的所有主要政治对手都抵制了这场选举。

cues.en: So Mr Farage's main challenger was Count Binface, a comedian dressed as a rubbish bin and a veteran of polls up and down the UK,
cues.zh: 因此，法拉奇先生的主要挑战者成了垃圾桶伯爵——一名打扮成垃圾桶的喜剧演员，也是英国各地选举的常客；

cues.en: including the Makerfield by-election won by the now Prime Minister, Andy Burnham.
cues.zh: 他还参加过由现任首相安迪·伯纳姆赢得的梅克菲尔德补选。

cues.en: Mr Farage did not attend the count, citing security concerns, but Count Binface did.
cues.zh: 法拉奇先生以安全问题为由没有出席计票现场，但垃圾桶伯爵去了。

cues.en: To hear the verdict of the Clactonites was the least I could do.
cues.zh: 来听听克拉克顿选民的裁决，是我至少能做的事。

cues.en: And why? Because I've had over 9,000 votes, guys.
cues.zh: 为什么？各位，因为我拿到了超过9000票。

cues.en: Now, in Makerfield eight weeks ago, I got 95 votes.
cues.zh: 八周前在梅克菲尔德，我只拿到95票。

cues.en: So against Nigel Farage, compared to Andy Burnham, I am 1,000 times more popular.
cues.zh: 所以，与挑战安迪·伯纳姆时相比，我对阵奈杰尔·法拉奇时受欢迎了1000倍。

cues.en: Extraordinarily, though, there is now a chance that voters will need to go to the polls again in Clacton in a few months' time.
cues.zh: 不过不同寻常的是，克拉克顿选民现在有可能在几个月后再次投票。

cues.en: That's because, moments after Mr Farage regained his seat,
cues.zh: 这是因为，法拉奇先生重新赢得席位后不久，

cues.en: a paused parliamentary investigation into whether he should have declared a gift of $6.7 million, or £5 million, was restarted.
cues.zh: 一项先前暂停的议会调查重新启动；调查要确定的是，他是否本应申报一笔价值670万美元、即500万英镑的赠礼。

cues.en: If he's found to have broken the rules, he could then be suspended from Parliament for long enough to trigger, yes, another by-election.
cues.zh: 如果他被认定违反规则，就可能被议会停职足够长的时间，从而触发——没错——又一场补选。

cues.en: Our UK political correspondent Rob Watson told me about this most colourful of by-elections.
cues.zh: 本台英国政治记者罗布·沃森向我介绍了这场色彩最为斑斓的补选。

cues.en: Goodness, I'll try and make sense of it.
cues.zh: 天哪，我来试着理清这件事。

cues.en: I'm not sure how successful I'm going to be here by the sea and the sand in Clacton-on-Sea.
cues.zh: 我现在就在克拉克顿海滨的海水和沙滩旁，不确定自己能不能说清楚。

cues.en: But, I mean, certainly of all the by-elections I've covered on and off for the last, I don't know, 40 years,
cues.zh: 不过，在我过去——我也说不准——40年间断断续续报道的所有补选中，

cues.en: It's definitely one of the oddest, because, you know, essentially you had Nigel Farage up against a man with a bin on his head
cues.zh: 这绝对是最奇特的补选之一，因为奈杰尔·法拉奇的对手是一个头戴垃圾桶的人，

cues.en: who claims, in a comedic way, to be a traveller from another planet—and he did remarkably well.
cues.zh: 他以喜剧方式自称是来自另一个星球的旅行者，而且表现出奇地好。

cues.en: And I don't think there's ever been a by-election where there were 34 candidates, so pretty extraordinary stuff.
cues.zh: 而且我认为，此前从未有过一场补选出现34名候选人，所以确实非同寻常。

cues.en: Yeah, 9,000 votes he got—that's not an insignificant amount of people.
cues.zh: 是啊，他拿到了9000票，这可不是一个小数目。

cues.en: But let's get on to this parliamentary inquiry that's restarting. What's going on with that, Rob?
cues.zh: 不过，我们来谈谈这项重新启动的议会调查。罗布，具体是怎么回事？

cues.en: Well, the Commissioner for Parliamentary Standards has made it clear that it is now resuming, now that Nigel Farage is becoming an MP again.
cues.zh: 议会标准事务专员已经明确表示，随着奈杰尔·法拉奇再次成为议员，调查现已恢复。

cues.en: So if the hope of Reform and its leader Nigel Farage had been that this by-election would sort of kill all that off, that is not happening.
cues.zh: 因此，如果英国改革党及其领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇原本希望这场补选能让整件事不了了之，那么这种情况并没有发生。

cues.en: And just to remind everyone briefly of the detail of it,
cues.zh: 简单回顾一下细节：

cues.en: essentially Nigel Farage was given a gift of £5 million from a cryptocurrency billionaire based in Thailand before the 2024 general election.
cues.zh: 在2024年大选前，奈杰尔·法拉奇从一名居住在泰国的加密货币亿万富翁那里获得了价值500万英镑的赠礼。

cues.en: Now, the rules state that even if you're not yet an MP, you should declare any gifts, certainly ones as big as that.
cues.zh: 相关规则规定，即便当时尚未成为议员，也应申报任何赠礼，尤其是金额如此之大的赠礼。

cues.en: Now, Nigel Farage said everything was all above board, that he hadn't done anything wrong, and that it was nothing to do with politics. But that now will be examined.
cues.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇表示，一切都完全合规，他没有做错任何事，此事也与政治无关。但这些说法现在将接受审查。

cues.en: What I can't tell you, Pete, is exactly how long that investigation will take or what it might come up with.
cues.zh: 皮特，我无法告诉你这项调查究竟会持续多久，也无法预料它可能得出什么结果。

cues.en: But the importance of it is that one of the things that's really been knocking Reform back—
cues.zh: 但此事的重要性在于，它是英国改革党真正遭受挫折的因素之一——

cues.en: and it's important to remember that it was leading in the polls in spring, its sort of populist right-wing message resonating with many—
cues.zh: 要记住，该党春季还曾在民调中领先，其带有民粹色彩的右翼主张引起许多人共鸣——

cues.en: but one of the things which really seems to have sort of eaten into that popularity is concerns about Nigel Farage and, indeed, the party's finances more widely.
cues.zh: 但似乎真正侵蚀其支持度的因素之一，是外界对奈杰尔·法拉奇以及该党更广泛财务状况的担忧。

cues.en: And what, if anything, then can that tell us about the state of British politics on a national level?
cues.zh: 那么，这件事究竟能在多大程度上说明英国全国政治的现状？

cues.en: Because, as you say, many had tipped Mr Farage, you know, to be the next prime minister following Andy Burnham, but his support had taken a bit of a hit.
cues.zh: 因为正如你所说，许多人此前看好法拉奇先生成为安迪·伯纳姆之后的下一任首相，但他的支持率有所下滑。

cues.en: But can we tell anything from his, you know, electoral success in the last 24 hours?
cues.zh: 不过，我们能否从他过去24小时的选举胜利中看出些什么？

cues.en: Well, it was probably a bit hasty to say he was going to become prime minister in a few years' time, and one would want to be cautious about reading too much from this by-election.
cues.zh: 说他几年后就会成为首相，可能有些操之过急；人们也应谨慎，不能过度解读这场补选。

cues.en: But I think you can say the following about British politics and where all this leaves us.
cues.zh: 但我认为，可以对英国政治及其当前局面作出以下判断。

cues.en: It tells you that things are very fluid, and that there are lots of big questions out there we can't answer.
cues.zh: 这说明局势变化很快，而且还有许多重大问题无法回答。

cues.en: The first one is: Can Nigel Farage and Reform bounce back?
cues.zh: 第一个问题是：奈杰尔·法拉奇和英国改革党能否卷土重来？

cues.en: Number two: Can Andy Burnham, the sort of newish leader of the Labour Party and Prime Minister,
cues.zh: 第二个问题是：新近出任工党领袖和首相的安迪·伯纳姆，

cues.en: can he maintain his bounce? And can the Conservatives somehow claw back some of the right-of-centre votes from Reform? Rob Watson.
cues.zh: 他能否维持支持率回升的势头？保守党又能否设法从英国改革党手中夺回部分中间偏右选票？罗布·沃森报道。

cues.en: To Spain, where the government has announced it's extending the life of the country's biggest nuclear plant.
cues.zh: 接下来关注西班牙。该国政府宣布，将延长国内最大核电站的运行寿命。

cues.en: The Almaraz plant was due to be decommissioned in two years' time.
cues.zh: 阿尔马拉斯核电站原定在两年后退役。

cues.en: But it will now remain open until 2030, despite previous plans to close all nuclear reactors by 2035 and focus on renewables.
cues.zh: 但该电站现在将运行至2030年，尽管此前的计划是到2035年关闭所有核反应堆，并重点发展可再生能源。

cues.en: Our global affairs reporter, Sebastian Usher, told me more.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍作了进一步介绍。

cues.en: It's the biggest nuclear power reactor in Spain.
cues.zh: 这是西班牙最大的核反应堆。

cues.en: It provides about 7% of the electricity output, the power output, so it's absolutely key, up until now, in terms of supply.
cues.zh: 它提供西班牙约7%的电力产出，所以至少到目前为止，它对电力供应绝对至关重要。

cues.en: I mean, this goes back a little while.
cues.zh: 我是说，这件事要从一段时间以前说起。

cues.en: This commitment by the left-leaning Spanish government to close down all the power stations by 2035,
cues.zh: 西班牙左翼政府承诺到2035年关闭所有核电站，

cues.en: so they can switch to renewables, was really meant to force that change through.
cues.zh: 转向可再生能源，目的正是推动这种转型。

cues.en: Intervening in between, of course, have been several things: the war in Ukraine first, and then the war in Iran, both of which have severely disrupted energy supplies.
cues.zh: 当然，其间出现了几个变数：先是乌克兰战争，随后是伊朗战争，两者都严重扰乱了能源供应。

cues.en: That has put more and more emphasis—not just in Spain, but in other European countries feeling this—on providing their own sources of power and energy, rather than importing it.
cues.zh: 这使得西班牙以及同样受到影响的其他欧洲国家越来越重视本土电力和能源供应，而不是依赖进口。

cues.en: So that's been one issue.
cues.zh: 这就是其中一个因素。

cues.en: And then last year, I don't know if people remember, but there was this massive power outage across the Iberian Peninsula,
cues.zh: 另外，不知道大家是否还记得，去年伊比利亚半岛发生大规模停电，

cues.en: both Spain and Portugal, and that again led to a rethinking.
cues.zh: 西班牙和葡萄牙都受到影响，这再次促使人们重新思考能源政策。

cues.en: So what the Spanish government said was that if the owners of these nuclear reactors had a good case to make for keeping them open a bit longer, then they would consider it.
cues.zh: 因此，西班牙政府表示，如果核反应堆业主能提出充分理由，说明应当延长运行时间，政府就会予以考虑。

cues.en: So what's happened is that they've done that; they've made the case.
cues.zh: 实际情况是，业主已经这样做了，提出了相关理由。

cues.en: The Spanish government has acceded to that to an extent.
cues.zh: 西班牙政府在一定程度上接受了这些理由。

cues.en: And the organisation that assesses the safety of nuclear reactors has also given it a clean bill of health.
cues.zh: 负责评估核反应堆安全的机构也认定该电站安全状况良好。

cues.en: So it's an extension by two years at the moment.
cues.zh: 因此，目前运行期限延长了两年。

cues.en: It does raise, obviously, the possibility of this happening with other reactors, where those companies have also suggested that they will be making the same kind of case.
cues.zh: 这显然也意味着其他反应堆可能获得类似延期，因为相关企业已表示也会提出同类理由。

cues.en: Sebastian Usher.
cues.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍报道。

cues.en: Police in Belgium are investigating after construction workers discovered a stash of gold treasure behind a wall in a house they were renovating.
cues.zh: 比利时警方正在调查一起事件：建筑工人在翻修一栋房屋时，在墙后发现了一批黄金宝藏。

cues.en: Gold bars and coins worth more than $10 million were found in a chest by workers in a town in eastern Flanders.
cues.zh: 工人在东佛兰德一座城镇的箱子里发现了价值超过1,000万美元的金条和金币。

cues.en: Alice Adderley reports.
cues.zh: 爱丽丝·阿德利报道。

cues.en: Imagine the surprise: you're carrying out a house renovation and, after knocking down a wall, you discover a chest containing millions of dollars' worth of gold.
cues.zh: 想象一下这种惊喜：你正在翻修房屋，敲掉一面墙后，竟发现一个装有价值数百万美元黄金的箱子。

cues.en: That's what happened in the small Flemish city of Dendermonde.
cues.zh: 这正是佛兰德小城登德尔蒙德发生的事。

cues.en: In the chest were at least 4,000 gold coins and more than 40 gold bars, dating from the 1950s and 60s.
cues.zh: 箱内至少有4,000枚金币和40多根金条，年代可追溯至20世纪50至60年代。

cues.en: Patrick Feys is the chief of police for Dendermonde.
cues.zh: 帕特里克·费斯是登德尔蒙德警察局长。

cues.en: We are certain that it has nothing to do with the Second World War, because the gold bars are from the 50s or the 60s.
cues.zh: 我们确定这与第二次世界大战无关，因为这些金条来自20世纪50或60年代。

cues.en: But we don't have any other clue why it was, yeah, hidden in the ground over there.
cues.zh: 但我们没有其他线索，不知道这些黄金为什么会被藏在那里。

cues.en: The house used to belong to a local brewer and now belongs to a charity, so the police are looking into who put the gold there and whether there was any crime involved.
cues.zh: 这栋房屋过去属于当地一家酿酒商，如今归一家慈善机构所有。警方正在调查是谁把黄金放在那里，以及是否涉及犯罪。

cues.en: Now it's very safe in the central safe of the federal government, and now we can start to discover who has put it over there.
cues.zh: 这些黄金如今安全存放在联邦政府的中央保险库里，我们可以开始查明究竟是谁把它放在那里的。

cues.en: Is there a criminal side to that gold, or is it just someone who has, yeah, put it away for later?
cues.zh: 这批黄金是否涉及犯罪，还是只是有人把它存放起来，准备以后再取？

cues.en: The police are warning prospectors to stay away from the house where it was discovered.
cues.zh: 警方警告寻宝者远离发现黄金的房屋。

cues.en: Don't come to the works over there; it's very dangerous.
cues.zh: 不要到那处工地来，那里非常危险。

cues.en: There are workers, you can't see anything, everything is gone.
cues.zh: 现场还有工人，你什么也看不到，所有东西都已经移走了。

cues.en: It's not a tourist place; it's too dangerous to discover something yourself.
cues.zh: 那里不是旅游景点，自己前去寻宝太危险了。

cues.en: The building belongs to a homeless charity, CAW, and its director general, Geert Hillaert, said he was surprised and amazed by the discovery.
cues.zh: 这栋建筑属于帮助无家可归者的慈善机构CAW。该机构总干事海尔特·希拉特表示，这一发现令他既意外又惊叹。

cues.en: We certainly aren't counting our chickens before they hatch at the moment, nor are we thinking about what we're going to do with it yet.
cues.zh: 目前我们当然不会过早乐观，也还没有考虑将来要如何处置这些黄金。

cues.en: Right now, we're mostly still surfing the wave of amazement, and we're also especially glad that it's safe.
cues.zh: 现在我们主要还沉浸在惊讶之中，也尤其庆幸这些黄金已被妥善保管。

cues.en: If they are found to be the legal owners, they hope to use the money to help local people who are down on their luck.
cues.zh: 如果最终确认CAW是合法所有者，他们希望用这笔钱帮助当地身处困境的人。

cues.en: Alice Adderley reporting.
cues.zh: 爱丽丝·阿德利报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.zh: 制作人是查兹·盖格和盖伊·皮特。
